title: Market Liquidity and Competition Among Designated Market Makers
authors: Mario Bellia; Loriana Pelizzon; Marti G. Subrahmanyam; Darya Yuferova

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 3-4 (overall effect and DMM competition; quoted/effective spreads, CAC 40 vs DAX 30)

eligible_reason: Not staggered. Quasi-natural experiment: NYSE Euronext Paris changed its Supplemental Liquidity Provider rules for all CAC 40 constituents on June 3, 2013; DAX 30 stocks are the control group. Equation (3): liquidity on SLP_d x CAC40_j with controls, stock x tick-size FE and day FE. One common date.
design_notes: Text Section 4.2; Table234.do etc. Window April 1 to July 31, 2013.
